en.title: Tanija (Agricultural E-Commerce Platform)
en.description: Acted as a Front-End Developer in creating an agricultural e-commerce platform aimed at supporting Indonesia's green economy. Responsible for transforming design mockups into a responsive, accessible, and user-friendly web interface to help farmers easily access high-quality agricultural supplies.

en.title: Kenyang (Interactive Food Discovery & Ordering Web Platform)
en.description: Built Kenyang Apps, an interactive web platform designed to simplify the food discovery and ordering process for users. Focused on developing a responsive and intuitive interface to ensure seamless menu navigation, delivering a highly satisfying user experience.

en.title: SPK Olahraga (Web-Based Decision Support System for Workout Recommendations)
en.description: Developed a web-based Decision Support System (DSS) designed to provide personalized workout recommendations for beginners to minimize injury risks. Built the system using PHP (Native), MySQL, and Bootstrap 5, integrating the Takagi-Sugeno Fuzzy Logic method to process subjective variables—such as fitness levels and health conditions—into accurate and safe recommendation scores.

en.title: Academic Success Factors Analysis
en.description: Conducted an in-depth analysis of over 6,000+ student data records to identify key variables influencing academic success. Utilized statistical approaches to uncover correlations between study habits, internal motivation, and socioeconomic factors, resulting in strategic recommendations such as standardized teacher training and digital facility interventions for underprivileged students.

en.title: Automated Sales Reporting System for Grocery Store
en.description: Built an automated grocery sales reporting system using Microsoft Excel as part of the KarirNex Intensive Bootcamp. The project involved rigorous data cleaning, implementing Data Validation to ensure accurate data entry, and utilizing Pivot Tables alongside complex formulas to generate structured transaction status reports and revenue summaries.

en.title: Business Insights with Power BI
en.description: Developed an end-to-end Power BI project focused on cleaning raw data using Power Query, which included handling case inconsistencies (uppercase/lowercase), trimming whitespace, removing duplicates, and managing anomaly quantities (such as -99 values). Created custom columns and designed an interactive dashboard for real-time sales performance monitoring.
